name: hf-worst-severe-requalification
purpose: Current-source requalification of the two frozen hf-disturbed propagation-breadth rows, with no experimental receiver policies. This model uses two independent Gaussian taps at 0 and 7 ms, each with 30 Hz full 2-sigma power-spectrum width, against the production HF Worst receiver allowance of 90 Hz and a 7 ms delay bound. The reference and weak rows retain their original seeds 9201/9202 and C/N0 levels 20/0 dB-Hz; they are separate seed/energy cases, not a matched-energy pair. Report complete delivery, DATA/null/erasure and physical quiet completion separately. Characterization preserves observed misses without converting them into process failures.
